name: outsystems-mcp-relay
stderr:
outsystems-mcp-relay v0.2.0

Usage: outsystems-mcp-relay <remote-url> [options]

A stdio-to-remote MCP relay with OAuth. Reads newline-delimited JSON-RPC on
stdin, forwards each frame to the remote MCP server, writes responses to stdout.

Options:
  --as-metadata-url <url>   OAuth AS metadata URL (default: discover from remote-url)
  --expected-issuer <url>   Override the RFC 9207 expected issuer. Use for proxies
                            that publish a rewritten metadata issuer but let the
                            backend stamp its own 'iss' in the auth response.
  --client-id <id>          Pre-registered client id (skips dynamic registration)
  --bearer <token>          Static bearer token mode (skips OAuth entirely)
  --no-auto-issuer          Disable auto-detection of the real AS issuer
  --force                   Ignore cached tokens and re-authenticate
  --help                    Show this help

Env: RELAY_TIMEOUT_MS (per-request timeout, default 120000)
By default the relay probes the authorize endpoint to auto-detect the real AS
issuer (proxy/Keycloak setups) instead of trusting the published metadata
issuer. --expected-issuer overrides; --no-auto-issuer disables.
Tokens are cached at ~/.mcp-auth/outsystems-mcp-relay-<sha1(url)>.json (0600).
